name: fairshare
description: Open-source, self-hostable Splitwise alternative with personal expense tracking. Split bills with friends, track spending, add expenses by voice (Siri/AI), settle up over UPI. PWA + Docker + MCP.

paragraphs: Split bills with friends and groups, track your own spending, add expenses by voice with Siri, and settle up over UPI. Free forever. No ads. No daily limits. Your data on your server.
Live app · Self-host in one command · Features · Siri & AI · MCP server
Splitwise now limits free users to a handful of expenses a day, shows ads, and paywalls basics like search and charts. And it only tracks shared money — your own spending lives in a different app.
features: Splitting with friends — who owes whom, per friend and per group, with the fewest payments to settle up.
Your own spending — every expense tagged Essential / Semi-essential / Luxury and by payment method (PhonePe, Google Pay, credit card, cash…), with a clear monthly summary.

Net worth — savings, mutual funds, stocks, FD, PPF, EPF, NPS, gold and loans in one place. Update the numbers once a month (or hand Claude a screenshot) and see what you've put in, what it's worth and your returns.
Friends, groups, and one-off shared expenses with any set of friends
